vcu_g_0159_2000102e.name: diag_fault_ticks
vcu_g_0159_2000102e.description: Ticks spent in display modes 2 and 3 (DAT_2000123E), counted by vcu_fault_warning_evaluate and capped at 4000. At 1500 ticks fault code 25 is stored and the output pulse latch (diag_fault19_pulse_state) arms. Zeroed while DAT_20001F48 is 1, by Ninebot command 1 and at start-up.

vcu_g_0159_20001030.name: diag_main_silence_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001030.description: Ticks since the last frame of the main group: IDs 0x310, 0x311, 0x420 to 0x425 and 0x500 to 0x502 (vcu_rx_frame_dispatch zeroes it on each). Capped at 1500. At 500 ticks fault code 21 is stored, below that it is cleared. Also zeroed while DAT_20001F48 is 1 and at start-up.

vcu_g_0159_20001032.name: diag_speed_limit
vcu_g_0159_20001032.description: Overspeed threshold of the current variant, probably in km/h. vcu_serial_parse_variant_code sets it to the high byte of DAT_20001B40 plus 3. Compared with the speed DAT_20001B62 / 10 by the overspeed debounce (diag_overspeed_debounce).

vcu_g_0159_2000123c.name: diag_fault_code_active
vcu_g_0159_2000123c.description: Active (displayed) fault code, 0 when none; fault codes are 1 to 48. Set by vcu_fault_code_store and vcu_fault_code_set (the latter also latches the code in diag_fault_bits). Cleared by vcu_error_code_clear_if_current and vcu_error_code_clear, and zeroed by vcu_error_state_reset. Copied to diag_fault_code_copy by the evaluator.

vcu_g_0159_2000123d.name: diag_warning_code_active
vcu_g_0159_2000123d.description: Active (displayed) warning code, 0 when none. vcu_warning_code_set keeps the lowest non-zero code. Codes 10 to 57 are latched in diag_warning_bits; codes 1 to 9 are not. Cleared by vcu_warning_code_clear and vcu_warning_state_reset. Copied to diag_warning_code_copy by the evaluator.

vcu_g_14a_200013d6.name: diag_overspeed_debounce_14a
vcu_g_14a_200013d6.description: Overspeed debounce counter in build 14a (same role as diag_overspeed_debounce in VCU_0159). Counts ticks while the speed is over diag_speed_limit, stores fault code 9 after more than 100 ticks, and is zeroed when the speed drops back under the limit.

vcu_g_153_20001472.name: diag_fault19_latch_153
vcu_g_153_20001472.description: Output-pulse state for fault code 25 in build 153 (same role as diag_fault19_pulse_state in VCU_0159). 0 idle, 1 armed, 2 after the pulse. The pulse drives GPIOA pin 12 low for 1000 ms, then high (probably a buzzer or lamp). Zeroed when fault 25 clears.

vcu_g_153_20001478.name: diag_overspeed_debounce_153
vcu_g_153_20001478.description: Overspeed debounce counter in build 153 (same role as diag_overspeed_debounce in VCU_0159): counts ticks over diag_speed_limit, stores fault code 9 after more than 100 ticks, zeroed when the speed is back under the limit.

vcu_g_0159_2000147c.name: diag_warning_change_latch
vcu_g_0159_2000147c.description: Cleared by vcu_fault_alert_repeat when the active warning code changes and while DAT_20001F48 is 1. Nothing in this build reads it, so it is probably a leftover (not verified).

vcu_g_0159_2000147d.name: diag_warning_code_last
vcu_g_0159_2000147d.description: Previous value of the active warning code (diag_warning_code_active), copied every tick by vcu_fault_alert_repeat. A change clears diag_warning_change_latch and diag_warning_change_ticks.

vcu_g_0159_2000147e.name: diag_fault19_pulse_state
vcu_g_0159_2000147e.description: Output-pulse state for fault code 25. Set to 1 when fault 25 has been active for 1500 ticks (vcu_fault_warning_evaluate); the next tick sets 2 and drives GPIOA pin 12 low for 1000 ms, then high. Returns to 0 when fault 25 clears. Probably drives a buzzer or lamp.

vcu_g_0159_20001480.name: diag_warning_change_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001480.description: Tick counter zeroed by vcu_fault_alert_repeat when the warning code changes or DAT_20001F48 is 1. It is never incremented in this build, so it is probably a leftover of an earlier alert pattern (not verified).

vcu_g_0159_20001482.name: diag_fault9_alert_countdown
vcu_g_0159_20001482.description: Countdown for alert 1 while overspeed fault 9 is active: loaded with 1000 and decremented each tick by vcu_fault_alert_repeat; at 0 it calls app_set_state(1) and reloads. Zeroed by vcu_fault_warning_evaluate when the speed is back under the limit.

vcu_g_0159_20001484.name: diag_overspeed_debounce
vcu_g_0159_20001484.description: Debounce counter for overspeed fault code 9: counts ticks while the speed DAT_20001B62 / 10 is above diag_speed_limit. After more than 100 ticks it stores fault code 9 and restarts. Zeroed when the speed is back under the limit.

vcu_g_0159_20001486.name: diag_fault_repeat_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001486.description: Ticks while a fault code is active and no warning code is active (vcu_fault_alert_repeat). Every 300 ticks, when the fault is 15, it calls app_set_state(4) (alert 4). Held at 0 while a warning is active or DAT_20001F48 is 1.

vcu_g_0159_20001488.name: diag_overtemp_debounce
vcu_g_0159_20001488.description: Debounce counter for fault code 40: counts ticks while diag_frame212_temp is at or above 196 (0xC4). After more than 100 ticks it stores fault code 40. Zeroed when the reading is below 196.

vcu_g_0159_20001878.name: diag_threshold_step
vcu_g_0159_20001878.description: Step of the two-step threshold alarm in vcu_threshold_alarm_latch: 0 idle, 1 after the first app_set_state(4) call, 2 after the second. Zeroed when the threshold condition clears.

vcu_g_0159_20001879.name: diag_threshold_latched
vcu_g_0159_20001879.description: Alarm-active flag of the threshold alarm: set to 1 when the condition first holds (it also sets DAT_20001FBC once and diag_alarm_code to 3), cleared when the condition clears.

vcu_g_0159_20001b64.name: diag_warning_code_copy
vcu_g_0159_20001b64.description: Copy of diag_warning_code_active, zero while the display mode DAT_2000123E is 0 (written by vcu_fault_warning_evaluate). Read by vcu_standby_entry_timer, which uses zero as the condition to enter standby (probably).

vcu_g_0159_20001b66.name: diag_fault_code_copy
vcu_g_0159_20001b66.description: Copy of diag_fault_code_active, zero while the display mode DAT_2000123E is 0 (written by vcu_fault_warning_evaluate). Zeroed by vcu_error_state_reset.

vcu_g_0159_20001cb4.name: diag_status_head
vcu_g_0159_20001cb4.description: First halfword of the 144-byte status area DAT_20001CB4 to DAT_20001D43 that vcu_identity_config_reload clears at start-up. Its accesses are 4 bytes wide and go through base pointers (Ninebot handler, threshold alarm, nibble-count snapshot), so the exact layout is not resolved. The other variables inside the area are documented elsewhere.

vcu_g_0159_20001cc4.name: diag_alarm_code
vcu_g_0159_20001cc4.description: Alarm code: set to 3 by vcu_threshold_alarm_latch while the threshold alarm is active and copied into the CAN payload by can_get_tx_payload_for_id. Cleared only by the start-up clear of the status area.

vcu_g_0159_20001cc6.name: diag_speed_raw
vcu_g_0159_20001cc6.description: Vehicle speed from frame 0x211 (payload bytes 6 and 7), probably in 0.1 km/h. Taken only when the value is below 600. Zeroed by vcu_fault_warning_evaluate after frame 0x211 has been silent for 300 ticks. vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update copies it to DAT_20001B62.

vcu_g_0159_20001cd8.name: diag_warning_bits
vcu_g_0159_20001cd8.description: Bitmap of latched warning codes in four 16-bit words. Bit i of word w is warning code 10 + 16 * w + i; word 3 is effectively unused because codes stop at 57. Set by vcu_warning_code_set, cleared by vcu_warning_code_clear and vcu_warning_state_reset, and turned into the code list by vcu_warning_list_rebuild.

vcu_g_0159_20001ce0.name: diag_fault_bits
vcu_g_0159_20001ce0.description: Bitmap of latched fault codes in three 16-bit words. Bit i of word w is fault code 1 + 16 * w + i (codes 1 to 48). Set by vcu_fault_code_set, cleared by vcu_error_code_clear, zeroed by vcu_error_state_reset, and expanded into the item list by vcu_flag_bitmap_expand.

vcu_g_0159_20001d44.name: diag_ram_write_head
vcu_g_0159_20001d44.description: First halfword of a RAM window (0x20001D44 to 0x20001F43) that the Ninebot-style command 0xAA in vcu_ninebot_frame_dispatch writes: it copies N bytes to 0x20001D44 + 2 * index for index below 255 and index + N/2 below 256. The only check is the sender byte (6 or 7). The window overlaps variables documented here (0x20001F36, 0x20001F40, 0x20001F42) and others, so it is probably a generic RAM-write path (see the report).

vcu_g_0159_20001f36.name: diag_frame425_temp
vcu_g_0159_20001f36.description: Raw payload byte 2 of frame 0x425 (probably a temperature): degrees C = raw - 50 (DAT_20001B8A holds that value times 10). Set to the sentinel 0x5AA5 ('no value') at start-up; vcu_fault_codes_4_5_eval does nothing while it holds the sentinel.

vcu_g_0159_20001f7e.name: diag_frame212_temp
vcu_g_0159_20001f7e.description: Raw payload byte 7 of frame 0x212, probably a controller temperature in degrees C. 0xFD and 0xFE mark an invalid reading and store fault code 34. Values from 196 (0xC4) feed diag_overtemp_debounce. vcu_drive_command_update derates from 20 upward (value minus 20).

vcu_g_0159_20001f80.name: diag_frame212_status
vcu_g_0159_20001f80.description: Low byte: payload byte 6 of frame 0x212, a controller status code. A non-zero value is latched as a warning code by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update. Values 11, 13, 18, 24, 55 and 56 also raise warning codes of the same number in vcu_fault_warning_evaluate. The high byte is written outside this packet and kept.

vcu_g_0159_20001f84.name: diag_frame401_value
vcu_g_0159_20001f84.description: Payload byte 5 of frame 0x401 (probably a temperature-like reading), stored as a 32-bit value. Values of 156 (0x9C) and above, except 0xFD and 0xFE, store fault code 41; anything below that, or 0xFD and 0xFE, clears it.

vcu_g_0159_2000224a.name: diag_warning_list
vcu_g_0159_2000224a.description: Elements 1 to 7 of the active warning code list (u16 codes 10 to 73, ascending), rebuilt by vcu_warning_list_rebuild from diag_warning_bits. Element 0 is at 0x20002248 (not in this packet). The number of entries is in DAT_200021E6.

vcu_g_0159_200022ce.name: diag_warning_bits_prev
vcu_g_0159_200022ce.description: Copy of diag_warning_bits (four words) taken by vcu_warning_list_rebuild to detect changes. vcu_display_frame_render_tick clears the first three words after a render.

vcu_g_0159_200022d8.name: diag_warning_list_dirty
vcu_g_0159_200022d8.description: Flag: 1 when the warning list must be rebuilt (set when the bitmap copy changed). vcu_warning_list_rebuild clears it after the rebuild, and vcu_display_frame_render_tick also writes it.
